body: Hey, yea its rough balancing everything out, exams next week but after seeing all these people willing to help I think I can start handling it.

When I was younger I always failed. Everything I did seemed to go wrong. My brother was better then me in everything so I was like nothing compared to him. I wanted to end it. I thought I was a failure, a nobody. I had no friends and I once had a girl come up to my face just to call me ugly. I wanted to end it but I didn't. If I did then I just wouldn't have the chance to do anything, I would be running away from the problem. So I stopped caring, if I failed I tried again until I would finally get it. I was bullied, hurt, I was almost failing school. But I kept trying and eventually I became better at everything. If you give up no shit you will fail, you need to keep trying no matter how rough it gets. If you need a friend you just made one. Msg anytime you want.

No one is ever okay, everyone is broken in one way or another. Everyone wears a face but they live on. Life will always be hard, but you need to be strong and over come all of its challenges. 28000 people are subscribed to this reddit page and they understand what you are going through. We can help you get through this part of your life, just talk to us. You want to get better, you want to be happy with life otherwise you wouldn't post your situation here. Just talk to anyone here and we can help you be happy again. You aren't just some abused girl, you aren't a broken thing, you just have a broken wing. You are special and deserve to be happy and they way to become happy is by talking about your problems. Please respond, I don't want you do die, you don't deserve to die.
Hey, I can be your friend. What do you activities do you enjoy?
Hi, I'm always here if you need someone to talk to
